topic_hills.text: Trams have climbed the steep hills of the Portuguese capital for more than a century.

topic_route.text: Tourists in Portugal often wait an hour to ride the yellow carriage of route 28.

topic_sights.text: Old public transport is among the most photographed sights on the Iberian coast.

words_cafe.text: Every visitor to the cafe opposite the Lisbon Tram Museum is offered a salted almond tart.

words_closed.text: The Lisbon Tram Museum is closed on Mondays and on the first day of every month.

words_shoes.text: Every visitor to Lisbon is asked by the guides to wear flat shoes on the cobbled streets.

close_chime.text: A small chime is sounded in many old museums to announce the closing hour.

close_album.text: Guests of famous galleries often leave long notes for the staff in a thick album.

close_shop.text: Museum shops in Lisbon sell pencils, postcards and tiny models of the trams.
